allow_missing_reason: The shipped object uses the pre-C++11 libstdc++ `std::string` ABI (`_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0`, `_ZNSs*` symbols). Modern libstdc++ only provides the C++11 SSO string, whose symbols have different mangling; the reconstructed construction/destruction of the same strings therefore calls `_ZNSt7__cxx1112basic_string...` instead.
allow_missing_strings_reason: GCC 15 merged the timer-name literals into one tail-shared `.rodata` blob, so the individual names are not recoverable as NUL-terminated strings by the gate's extractor; the exact bytes are present at flex.part4.cu (names vector).
